_comment: versionCode is the number Play counts uploads by. It must be higher than
the highest Play has ever accepted for com.phaserugbymanager.app, which
was 29. Before that: 28 was 1.5.7 internal testing, 27 was 1.5.6,
19 was 1.3.0, the first build with adverts, 5 Sep 2026; 17 was 1.2.9 and
15 the last TWA. Go up by one for every upload, record what Play accepted
here, and never reuse a number.
A VERSION CODE IS SPENT BY THE FIRST TRACK THAT TAKES IT, not by the
release reaching anybody. 28 went to Internal testing and Closed testing
then refused the same bundle - 'Version code 28 has already been used' -
because Play counts codes per app, across every track at once. Promoting
the existing release between tracks reuses the code; a second upload
cannot. 29 is the same 1.5.7 build, for the closed track.
30 IS 1.5.8, FOR THE CLOSED TRACK. 29 was the same 1.5.7 build, also
closed, 10 Sep 2026 - spent because 28 had already gone to Internal
testing and Play would not take the bundle a second time. Upload 30 to
Closed testing and nowhere else, then PROMOTE it if another track needs
it; a second upload of the same bundle cannot reuse the number.
31 IS 1.6.2, FOR THE CLOSED TRACK. Three versions were finished and never
uploaded - 1.5.9, 1.6.0 and 1.6.1 - and all three ship inside 1.6.2. NONE
OF THEM SPENT A CODE, because a code is spent by the first track that takes
a bundle and no bundle ever went up for any of them. That is the one saving
grace of a version that does not ship: it costs nothing as long as nothing
was uploaded. 31 is still the next number.
Upload 31 to Closed testing and nowhere else, then PROMOTE it if another
track needs it.
32 IS 1.6.3, the release-gate fixes (docs/release-audit-v1.6.2.md). 31 was
uploaded to the closed track for 1.6.2 and is spent whether or not it was
promoted; never reuse it.
33 IS 1.6.4: the URC format, the women's World Championship, the forfeit
rule, the id counter in the save and the women's squad reconciliation.
34 WAS SPENT by an upload that never became a release (16 Sep 2026: Play
took the bundle, the release page then showed no bundle, and the next
upload of 34 was refused as already used). 35 IS 1.6.5: one calendar with
an invariant, the relegation playoff on finals day, Premiership relegation
restored, the runtime-brief fixes.
versionName comes from the root package.json.
billingLibrary is the Play Billing Library version PhaseBilling.java is
written against. Play refuses anything below 8.0.0 (learned 4 Sep 2026).
